quarterly_data.quarter: NuScale Power press release: NuScale Power and MillenniTEK Advance Manufacturing (09-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NuScale and MillenniTEK, an advanced nuclear materials manufacturer, fabricated first-of-a-kind boron-oxide pellets for NuScale's passive emergency core cooling system (ECCS); the pellets dissolve into the reactor coolant on ECCS actuation to control core reactivity without operator intervention. CEO: working with manufacturers like MillenniTEK progresses 'the production-ready processes needed to support our first customer deployments'. A manufacturing-process milestone, not a stated production order.
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: supplier (boron-oxide pellets for the ECCS; manufacturing development)
